PLEASE JOIN THE MAILING LIST AND FOLLOW ON INSTAGRAM FOR UPDATES THE WELTSCHMERZ OCTAVE FUZZ FEATURES A SINGLE SUB OCTAVE STRIPPED FROM THE OC-2 TOPOLOGY RUNNING INTO A HEAVILY TWEAKED OPAMP BASED SQUARE-WAVE FUZZ FROM THE SCHUMANN PLL. THE RESULTING COMBO AND ADDITIONAL CONTROLS ALLOWS A RANGE OF SOUNDS FROM HEAVY OCTAVE FUZZ TO SUB SYNTH TONES WITH CHAOTIC NOTE DROPPING GLITCHES. WITH A CLEAN BLEND FEATURED ON BOTH THE OCTAVE AND THE FUZZ THE WELTSCHMERZ IS SUITABLE FOR GUITAR AND BASS - THIS ALSO MEANS BOTH THE FUZZ AND THE OCTAVE CAN FUNCTION SEPARATELY AND BE BLENDED IN PARALLEL WITH ANY OTHER PEDAL CHAIN. IT ALSO INCLUDES A SWITCHABLE DRONE MODE THAT TURNS THE OCTAVE PART OF THE CIRCUIT INTO A FEEDBACK DRONE THAT CAN BE UTILISED AS AN INDIVIDUAL INSTRUMENT. THE ENCLOSURE IS A CUSTOM DESIGNED FOUR PIECE SHEET METAL DESIGN PRODUCED IN AN UNFINISHED AESTHETIC AND AS SUCH MAY FEATURE SCRATCHES AND MACHINE MARKS. EVERY PEDAL WILL SHIP WITH A REMOVAL GUIDE PLATE TO LEARN THE CONTROLS OCT CONTROLS THE OCTAVE VOLUME / INTENSITY BLD CONTROLS A CLEAN BLEND IN PARALLEL TO THE OCTAVE / ALSO CONTROLLABLE BY EXPRESSION [COMPATIBLE WITH THE MOOG-EP3, ERNIE BALL AND SIMILAR] WAV CONTROLS THE WAVESHAPE OF THE FUZZ / INCREASES TREBLE NOISE WHEN TURNED RIGHT FZZ CONTROLS THE LEVEL OF FUZZ / INCREASES LEVEL OF GAIN AND OVERALL VOLUME TNE ACTIVE EQ CONTROLS THE TONE OF THE FUZZ / INCREASE TREBLE TO THE LEFT / MORE BASS TO THE RIGHT GTE CONTROLS THE NOISEGATE OF THE FUZZ / MIDDLE DETENT EQUALS NO GATING. VERY SENSITIVE AND CAN BE TURNED A MINIMAL AMOUNT TO CUT BACKGROUND NOISE AT EXTREME SETTINGS. VOL CONTROLS THE MASTER VOLUME OF THE FUZZ < > CONTROLS A CLEAN BLEND IN PARALLEL TO THE FUZZ BOTH SWITCHES ARE ON RELAY AND CAN BE USED MOMENTARILY AS WELL AS PERMANENTLY. RED MODE INDICATES FUZZ ONLY / YELLOW MODE IS ISOLATED OCTAVE / ORANGE IS BOTH COMBINED. SIGNAL ROUTE IS OCTAVE INTO FUZZ / WITH OCTAVE OFF < > BECOMES A CLEAN BLEND FOR THE FUZZ OCTAVE TRACKING ARTIFACTING INCREASES WITH LOWER END / OCTAVE RUNS AT UNITY GAIN BY DEFAULT WHEN CHANGING THE GAIN OF THE FUZZ OR < > BLEND YOU CAN ADAPT THE FUZZ VOL TO ALIGN UNITY DRONE MODE SWITCH IS ACTIVE WHEN OCTAVE MODE IS ON / FUZZ MODE ADDS FURTHER SONIC OPTIONS THIS ITEM IS NOT SUBJECT TO TARIF
